paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of data entries across different task categories. The dataset primarily consists of Math (29.3%), Coding (24.3%), and Information Seeking (22.2%) tasks, followed by Reasoning (10.4%), Planning (2.3%), Creative Writing (2.2%), and other combined categories (9.3%).

annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different categories, presenting data in seven slices. The categories included are Math, represented in red, comprising 29.3% of the chart; Coding, shown in blue, making up 24.3%; Information Seeking, in green, accounting for 22.2%; Reasoning, in orange, covering 10.4%; Planning, depicted in purple, at 2.3%; Creative Writing, in pink, representing 2.2%; and Others (combined), displayed in a light green section, constituting 9.3% of the total. The chart includes a legend positioned at the top-left corner and percentage labels inside each slice for clarity. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size. There is no visual emphasis on any particular slice, such as explosions or offsets.
